info.title: Facturacion SIFEN API
info.description: Electronic invoicing for Paraguay (SIFEN). Authenticate with an API key: `Authorization: Bearer sk_live_...`. Errors use `{ statusCode, message, errors? }`. Webhook payloads and signatures are described in docs/integracion/webhooks.md. Project documentation (PRD, ADRs, plan, operations) is browsable in the [guides](/docs/guides).

post.description: Returns 202 once the document is persisted with its CDC; signing and transmission to SIFEN are asynchronous. Retrying with the same `Idempotency-Key` and body returns the same response; the same key with another body is a 409.

post.description: Stores the XML and extracts it; the processing contract is asynchronous (202), although a SIFEN XML is read before the answer. The status in the body is `confirmed` when the document passes validation, `needs_review` otherwise. A document whose receiver is not the tenant (`is_own_receiver` false) is stored the same way but never produces webhook events. Webhooks `reception.document.needs_review` and `reception.document.confirmed` announce the result (see docs/integracion/recepcion.md). Send the XML as a raw `application/xml` or `text/xml` body, as a `multipart/form-data` upload with one `file` part, or as JSON `{ "xml": "<...>" }` (JSON is limited to 1 MiB). Content is recognized by its first bytes, not by the declared type. The same bytes, or the same CDC, uploaded again answer 200 with the existing document. PDF, photo and CDC-only requests answer 422 `unsupported_source` for now. The maximum upload size is `RECEPTION_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES` (default 2 MiB). Errors carry a stable `code`.

403.description: The API key lacks the required scope

413.description: The upload exceeds the maximum size (`payload_too_large`)

415.description: The bytes do not look like XML (`unsupported_media_type`)

422.description: `unsupported_source` (PDF, photo, CDC only), `extraction_failed` (stored but unreadable; carries `document_id`), `empty_upload` or `invalid_request`

get.summary: List received documents, newest first, cursor paginated
get.description: Ordered by creation time, newest first. Pass the `next_cursor` of a page as `cursor` to get the next one; it is null on the last page. `issued_from` and `issued_to` are inclusive calendar days; `updated_since` is an inclusive ISO 8601 timestamp for incremental sync.

get.description: Everything an ERP needs to render its own review: extracted fields, items, per-field confidences, `needs_review_reasons` and the artifact link. Money is a decimal string. Soft-removed items are not listed. `version` is what `PATCH` expects.

patch.summary: Correct a received document and, optionally, confirm it, in one call
patch.description: Allowed in `needs_review` and `confirmed` only. Send the `version` you read (optimistic lock, no `If-Match`); a stale one answers 409 `version_conflict` with `current_version`. Absent fields keep their value, `null` clears a nullable one. Items are addressed by `position` (yours to choose, never reused): an existing position is modified, a new one is added, `remove: true` soft-removes it (the row is retained, reads skip it). With `confirm: true`, or when the document is already `confirmed`, the result is revalidated: a failure answers 422 `validation_failed` with `reasons` and NOTHING is saved (not even the corrections). Without `confirm`, a `needs_review` document stays in `needs_review`, its `version` increases and `needs_review_reasons` are refreshed (`awaiting_confirmation` when the data is valid but unconfirmed). Repeating a request that was already applied (same actor, previous `version`) answers 200 with `Idempotent-Replayed: true` and writes nothing. The response is the same shape as `GET`. Webhook echo contract: editing a `confirmed` document emits `reception.document.updated` with `data.actor` (`{ type: "api_key", id }`), `data.version` and `data.status`, also to the endpoints of the caller. To ignore its own echo an ERP discards the event when `data.actor.type` is `api_key`, `data.actor.id` is the id of its API key and `data.version` equals the `version` returned by this operation; see docs/integracion/webhooks.md.

status.description: Current status; a re-upload returns whatever status the document has reached

is_own_receiver.description: False when the receiver RUC is not the tenant`s own

ReceivedDocumentDetail.description: Money and quantities are decimal strings; confidences are decimal strings in [0, 1]. `PATCH` accepts the same nested names.

artifact_url.description: Path of `GET /v1/received-documents/{id}/artifact` (needs the API key); null without artifact
